name: USEA
rootCause: A Rug Pull occurred on the USEA token on BNB Chain with a loss of about $1.1 million, and the deployer minted a total of 700 million USEAs via the mint function, then transferred them to EOA addresses and sold 1114468 BUSD via PancakeSwap V3.
